blocks.orig: Surrounded by the endless plains of the Serengeti, Matawi Serengeti Tented Camp is a combination of comfort and wilderness. The camp features 7 tents on raised wooden platforms that reflect the glamour of old Africa. Decorated in earthy tones and clean lines, they feature warm wooden-plank floors, king-size beds with mosquito nets, a sitting area, a work desk and a spacious bathroom with a claw-foot bath, shower and hot water. From the bed, as well as from your private terrace, you have a breathtaking panoramic view. Whether you choose to take your meals in the dining tent or under the open sky, a renowned chef will take care of your palate, and in the evening, you can reflect on the day around the campfire. And in this romantic oasis of tranquillity, a solar system provides you with electricity and even Wi-Fi (might you still need it!).
blocks.html: Set amid the endless Serengeti plains, Matawi Serengeti Tented Camp brings together comfort and wilderness. Its 7 tents stand on raised wooden platforms and capture the glamour of old Africa. With earthy colours and clean lines, they have warm wooden-plank floors, king-size beds with mosquito nets, a sitting area, a desk and a large bathroom with a claw-foot bath, a shower and hot water. Both from your bed and from your private terrace you enjoy a stunning panoramic view. You can have your meals in the dining tent or under the open sky, and either way a renowned chef looks after your taste buds; in the evening you can look back on the day by the campfire. In this romantic, peaceful oasis, solar power supplies electricity and even Wi-Fi (in case you still need it!).
